summary: First-pass smoke test of OpenDroid Sandbox. All 10 backend REST endpoints, WebSocket streaming, and full frontend UI flow (command center, sidebar, niche switch, dropdashin panel, publish, flush) all pass. No blockers found.
passed: GET /api/ returns service info with 10 networks (incl. dropdashin, NOT telegram) and 4 niches
GET /api/state returns tick, totals (earnings/impressions/clicks/conversions/conv_rate), 10 networks, dropdashin object, series array
GET /api/networks lists all 10 including dropdashin, telegram absent
GET /api/niches returns finance_saas_affiliate, ecommerce_drop, health_fitness, entertainment_viral
POST /api/niche {key:ecommerce_drop} switches niche; /api/state reflects change
GET /api/feed/instagram returns posts with post_id, author, algorithmic_weight, sentiment_index
POST /api/agents/publish returns {post, llm} with llm.provider='sim' and valid post_id
POST /api/sandbox/flush resets totals (conversions=0, earnings dropped from 24033 to ~230 next tick)
GET /api/llm/status returns provider='sim' with all readiness flags
WebSocket /api/ws/analytics: initial snapshot then tick events (~1Hz) with totals/networks/series_point
Dropdashin sim active: at tick ~93 orders=700, gross_sales=$27929, driven by cross-traffic
conv_rate non-zero after ~15s (0.0309)
Frontend command-center loads at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL
Header shows 'ws: live' (WS connected)
Sidebar renders all 10 nav-* testids (facebook..dropdashin)
Niche selector switches to E-commerce/Dropshipping and header label updates
nav-dropdashin renders DropdashinPanel (ORDERS 231, NET PROFIT $7256.50, GROSS SALES $9216.90, AD SPEND $66.20 visible)
Publish flow: publish-input + publish-btn works; post 'hello sandbox test post' appears in feed
Top metrics update in real-time (Total Earnings, Aggregated Traffic /s, Avg Conversion)
Live chart renders with two lines (revenue green + imp/sec cyan)
Flush button triggers 'sandbox flushed' toast
No console errors during full UI walkthrough
notes: LLM provider correctly defaults to 'sim' (deterministic) — no external LLM calls needed. All social platforms simulated as designed.
